title: Friends or Neighbors? Advice Networks, Geographic Proximity, and the Transmission of Health Knowledge
title_zh: 朋友还是邻居？建议网络、地理邻近性与健康知识的传播

abstract: We document market power in U.S. equity securities lending and examine its origins and consequences. We develop a dynamic model of securities lending and estimate it on the cross-section of U.S. equities, showing that the dominant custodian-intermediated market structure emerges as a response to short sellers’ information-leakage concerns. Short sellers prefer this opaque market structure over a centralized alternative, particularly for smaller stocks, despite the associated non-competitive fees. This is because their trading strategies become unprofitable if information leaks prematurely. Thus, unlike in standard product markets, the demand side in securities lending values opacity, which is important for regulatory design.
abstract_zh: 我们记录了美国股票证券借贷中的市场势力，并考察了其起源与后果。我们构建了一个证券借贷的动态模型，并基于美国股票截面数据进行了估计，结果表明，以托管机构为中介的主导型市场结构是对卖空者信息泄露担忧的回应。尽管这种不透明的市场结构伴随着非竞争性费用，但卖空者仍偏好于此，而非集中化替代方案，尤其是对于小盘股而言。这是因为，如果信息过早泄露，他们的交易策略将无利可图。因此，与标准产品市场不同，证券借贷的需求方看重不透明性，这对监管设计具有重要意义。
title: Market Power in the Securities Lending Market*
title_zh: 证券借贷市场中的市场势力

abstract: Daily Google Trends data exhibit systematic day-of-week patterns that can contaminate spike detection in attention-based event studies. Applying a standard algorithm to raw data for 23 U.S. equities yields substantially more detected spikes than applying the same algorithm after weekday correction, with the excess concentrated on mid-week days. Validation against earnings announcements, SEC filings, and abnormal trading volume shows that weekday-corrected spikes align more closely with attention-relevant benchmarks than raw spikes. Researchers using daily Google Trends in threshold-based event studies should test for day-of-week seasonality and correct it when present.
abstract_zh: 每日谷歌趋势数据呈现出系统性的星期效应模式，这可能污染基于注意力的事件研究中的尖峰检测。将标准算法应用于23只美国股票的原始数据，所检测到的尖峰数量显著多于在星期校正后应用同一算法所得的结果，且多余尖峰集中在一周中间的日子。通过与盈利公告、美国证券交易委员会文件以及异常交易量的验证表明，星期校正后的尖峰比原始尖峰更紧密地与注意力相关基准对齐。使用每日谷歌趋势进行基于阈值的事件研究的研究者，应检验星期季节性，并在存在时予以校正。
title: Weekday bias in daily Google Trends spike detection
title_zh: 日度谷歌趋势峰值检测中的工作日偏差

abstract: This paper studies the optimal inflation target in a tractable heterogeneous agent New Keynesian (THANK) model with an occasionally binding zero lower bound, incorporating income inequality, income risk, and countercyclical fiscal policy. We analytically characterize how cyclical and long-run inequality, income risk, and fiscal policy shape the welfare trade-off of trend inflation across households. Greater cyclical inequality and income risk increase the marginal benefits of inflation, especially for hand-to-mouth (HtM) households, while long-run inequality reduces marginal benefits. Quantitatively, income inequality and income risk modestly raise the utilitarian optimal inflation rate relative to the representative agent benchmark. We further show that countercyclical fiscal policies lower the marginal benefit of inflation for all households and reduce the optimal inflation target. Finally, adding wealth inequality in the form of private or government debt, in addition to income inequality, raises the optimal inflation target.
abstract_zh: 本文在一个具有偶尔约束零下限的可处理异质性代理人新凯恩斯（THANK）模型中，研究了最优通胀目标，该模型纳入了收入不平等、收入风险及逆周期财政政策。我们从理论上刻画了周期性及长期不平等、收入风险与财政政策如何影响跨家庭趋势通胀的福利权衡。更大的周期性不平等和收入风险增加了通胀的边际收益，尤其是对于手到口（HtM）家庭而言，而长期不平等则降低了边际收益。在量化上，相对于代表性代理人基准，收入不平等和收入风险适度提高了功利主义最优通胀率。我们进一步表明，逆周期财政政策降低了所有家庭通胀的边际收益，并减少了最优通胀目标。最后，在收入不平等之外，加入以私人或政府债务形式存在的财富不平等，会提高最优通胀目标。
title: Household Income Inequality and Optimal Trend Inflation
title_zh: 家庭收入不平等与最优趋势通胀

abstract: The stochastic block model (SBM) has been widely used to analyze network data. Various goodness-of-fit tests have been proposed to assess the adequacy of model structures. To the best of our knowledge, however, none of the existing approaches are applicable for sparse networks in which the connection probability of any two communities is of order log(n)/n, and the number of communities is divergent. To fill this gap, we propose a novel goodness-of-fit test for the stochastic block model. The key idea is to construct statistics by sampling the maximum entry-deviations of the adjacency matrix that the negative impacts of network sparsity are alleviated by the sampling process. We demonstrate theoretically that the proposed test statistic converges to the Type-I extreme value distribution under the null hypothesis regardless of the network structure. Accordingly, it can be applied to both dense and sparse networks. In addition, we obtain the asymptotic power against alternatives. Moreover, we introduce a bootstrap-corrected test statistic to improve the finite sample performance, recommend an augmented test statistic to increase the power, and extend the proposed test to the degree-corrected SBM. Simulation studies and two empirical examples with both dense and sparse networks indicate that the proposed method performs well.
abstract_zh: 随机块模型（SBM）已被广泛用于分析网络数据。为评估模型结构的充分性，已有多种拟合优度检验方法被提出。然而，据我们所知，现有方法均不适用于连接概率为log(n)/n量级且社区数量发散的稀疏网络。为填补这一空白，我们提出了一种针对随机块模型的新型拟合优度检验方法。其核心思想是通过采样邻接矩阵的最大条目偏差来构造统计量，从而通过采样过程减轻网络稀疏性的负面影响。我们从理论上证明，在原假设下，所提出的检验统计量收敛于第一类极值分布，且与网络结构无关。因此，该方法可同时适用于稠密和稀疏网络。此外，我们获得了备择假设下的渐近功效。进一步地，我们引入了一种基于自助法的修正统计量以提升有限样本性能，推荐了一种增强统计量以增加检验功效，并将所提检验扩展至度修正的SBM。模拟研究及两个涵盖稠密与稀疏网络的实证案例表明，所提方法表现良好。
title: A goodness-of-fit test for sparse networks
title_zh: 稀疏网络拟合优度检验

abstract: We estimate the causal effect of online sports betting on households’ investment, spending, and debt management decisions using household transaction data and a staggered difference-in-differences framework. Following legalization, sports betting spreads quickly, with both the number of participants and frequency of bets increasing over time. This increase does not displace other gambling or consumption but significantly reduces savings, as risky bets crowd out positive expected value investments. These effects concentrate among frequent bettors and low-savings households. Our findings highlight the potential adverse effects of online sports betting on vulnerable households.
abstract_zh: 我们利用家庭交易数据和交错双重差分框架，估计了在线体育博彩对家庭投资、支出及债务管理决策的因果效应。合法化后，体育博彩迅速普及，参与人数和投注频率均随时间增加。这一增长并未挤占其他赌博或消费活动，但显著减少了储蓄，因为高风险投注排挤了具有正期望值的投资。这些影响集中在频繁投注者和低储蓄家庭中。我们的研究结果凸显了在线体育博彩对弱势家庭可能产生的不利影响。
title: Gambling away stability: Sports betting’s impact on vulnerable households
title_zh: 赌博侵蚀稳定：体育博彩对脆弱家庭的影响

abstract: Variations in the low- and high-frequency components of temperature may have distinct impacts on economic outcomes. Parametric and non-parametric estimates from three panels of data all find significant heterogeneity in the relative importance of the two components, but there is clear evidence in each panel of a common, slowly evolving low-frequency factor that is highly correlated with the low-frequency factor of economic activity. In regressions that quantify the output effects of the components, we find that one-way clustered standard errors often lead to size distortions, and that an additive fixed effect specification does not adequately control for common time effects. Using bootstrap inference to assess estimates from our preferred interactive fixed effect specification, we only find a marginally significant effect of the high-frequency component on growth in the U.S. panel. However, the effect of the low-frequency component is significant in the European and International panels, suggesting that the increase in the low-frequency temperature component over the post-1980 period is associated with a reduction in economic growth of approximately 1.3 percentage points. The findings are corroborated by time series estimation using data at the unit and national levels.
abstract_zh: 温度的低频与高频成分变化可能对经济产出产生不同影响。基于三组面板数据的参数与非参数估计均发现，这两种成分的相对重要性存在显著异质性，但每组数据中均清晰显示出一个共同的、缓慢演变低频因子，该因子与经济活动的低频因子高度相关。在量化各成分对产出影响的回归分析中，我们发现单向聚类标准误常导致规模失真，且加性固定效应模型未能充分控制共同时间效应。采用自助法推断评估我们偏好的交互固定效应模型估计结果时，仅在美国面板中发现高频成分对增长的边际显著效应。然而，在欧洲和国际面板中，低频成分的影响显著，表明1980年后低频温度成分的上升与经济增长率约1.3个百分点的下降相关联。这些发现通过使用单位和国家层面数据的时间序列估计得到了进一步证实。
title: The economic impact of low- and high-frequency temperature changes
title_zh: 低频与高频温度变化的经济影响

abstract: We examine how tax policy affects firm compliance, drawing on a 2003 tax incentive implementation campaign in Chongqing, China. Local officials promoted a preferential corporate income tax rate treatment (15% versus 33%) under the Western Development Project through door-to-door visits. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that firms became more likely to report positive profits at the extensive margin, leading to higher declared profits and tax payments. For newly compliant firms, the increases came from reported sales and costs rather than real growth in investment or employment. In contrast, consistently compliant firms raised investment and employment, while output did not increase significantly in the short run. Overall, these responses increased local fiscal revenue by about 24%. The findings show that compliance can be improved not only by deterrence but also by credible and favorable tax regimes.
abstract_zh: 我们基于2003年重庆市实施的一项税收激励政策，考察税收政策如何影响企业合规行为。当地官员通过上门走访，在西部大开发项目下推广优惠企业所得税税率（15%对33%）。采用双重差分设计，我们发现企业在广泛边际上更有可能报告正利润，从而导致申报利润和纳税额增加。对于新合规企业，增长主要来自申报的销售额和成本，而非投资或就业的实际增长。相比之下，持续合规的企业增加了投资和就业，但短期内产出并未显著增长。总体而言，这些反应使地方财政收入增加了约24%。研究结果表明，合规性不仅可以通过威慑手段提升，还可以通过可信且优惠的税收制度来改善。
china_relevance_reason: journal or topic scope is China economy
title: Tax incentives and firm compliance: Evidence from China
title_zh: 税收激励与企业合规：来自中国的证据

abstract: We identify the liquidity channel through which Federal Reserve quantitative easing (QE) and quantitative tightening (QT) affect capital flows to emerging markets. Using weekly data on the Fed’s purchases and sales of long-term U.S. Treasury securities, we find that large purchases lead to a significant increase in capital flows to emerging markets, and that sales have the reverse effect. We then show that QE lowers, and QT raises, the convenience yield on U.S. Treasuries, measured by covered interest parity deviations, and that the induced changes in the convenience yield drive the capital flow responses. Our model based on liquidity rationalizes these findings: QE shifts publicly held government debt toward more liquid assets, providing investors a greater buffer against the risk of low consumption. Better insured through liquid asset holdings, investors are willing to increase illiquid investments, including lending to emerging markets.
abstract_zh: 我们识别了美联储量化宽松（QE）与量化紧缩（QT）影响新兴市场资本流动的流动性渠道。利用美联储购买和出售长期美国国债的周度数据，我们发现大规模购买显著增加了流向新兴市场的资本，而出售则产生相反效应。随后，我们证明QE降低了美国国债的便利收益率，而QT则提高了该收益率，这一指标通过覆盖利率平价偏差来衡量，且由此引发的便利收益率变化驱动了资本流动的反应。我们基于流动性的模型合理化了这些发现：QE将公众持有的政府债务转向更具流动性的资产，为投资者提供了应对低消费风险的更大缓冲。通过持有流动性资产获得更好的保障后，投资者更愿意增加非流动性投资，包括向新兴市场放贷。
title: U.S. liquid government liabilities and emerging market capital flows
title_zh: 美国流动性政府负债与新兴市场资本流动

abstract: Using a structural vector autoregression, I document the dominant role of fiscal policy in the recent surge of inflation in the United States. The comovement of output, prices, and primary deficits yields a set of identifying restrictions that allow me to estimate the causal effects of exogenous fiscal shocks. I show that fiscal policy has long been an important driver of inflation, with its unusually large role in the recent inflation surge reflecting the unprecedented scale of fiscal interventions. In the euro area, fiscal policy also contributed to inflation, and the timing of interventions helps explain why the surge lagged behind that in the United States.
abstract_zh: 利用结构向量自回归模型，我记录了财政政策在美国近期通胀飙升中的主导作用。产出、价格与基本赤字之间的联动性提供了一组识别约束，使我能够估计外生财政冲击的因果效应。我表明，财政政策长期以来一直是通胀的重要驱动因素，其在近期通胀飙升中异常显著的作用反映了财政干预的空前规模。在欧元区，财政政策同样对通胀有所贡献，而干预时机的差异有助于解释为何该地区的通胀飙升滞后于美国。
title: Fiscal shocks and the surge of inflation
title_zh: 财政冲击与通胀飙升

abstract: This paper examines how increased trade in renewable nature-based inputs — such as wild terrestrial and marine biomass, along with tradable forms of clean air, soil, and water — affects economic growth in a world constrained by finite natural capital. Using a standard two-region endogenous growth model, we introduce two novel features: (i) a framework that explicitly models nature-based inputs by accounting for both the stock of natural capital and the flow of ecosystem services it generates, and (ii) ecological tipping points—thresholds beyond which natural capital and the ecosystems that sustain it may undergo irreversible degradation. We find that while global integration benefits all regions in the long run, it slows growth in nature-rich countries during the transition due to over-specialization and increased dependence on foreign technology. However, when tipping points are considered, agents internalize the risk of ecological collapse, reduce resource extraction, and shift toward innovation. Coordinated innovation and conservation policies can support more balanced and sustainable development.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在受有限自然资本约束的世界中，可交易的可再生自然基础投入品——如野生陆地和海洋生物质，以及可交易形式的清洁空气、土壤和水——贸易增加如何影响经济增长。通过使用标准的双区域内生增长模型，我们引入了两个新特征：（i）一个明确建模自然基础投入品的框架，同时考虑自然资本存量及其产生的生态系统服务流量；（ii）生态临界点——超过这些阈值，自然资本及其维持的生态系统可能遭受不可逆转的退化。我们发现，尽管全球一体化长期内惠及所有区域，但在转型期间，由于过度专业化和对外国技术的依赖增加，它减缓了自然丰富国家的增长。然而，当考虑临界点时，行为主体会内化生态崩溃的风险，减少资源开采，并转向创新。协调一致的创新与保护政策可以支持更加平衡和可持续的发展。
title: Trade, innovation, and natural capital: Growth dynamics near ecological thresholds
title_zh: 贸易、创新与自然资本：生态阈值附近的增长动态

abstract: We study, theoretically and experimentally, the impact of performance thresholds on effort and risk-taking. Our theory predicts that thresholds typically increase effort provision, but that the magnitude of this increase varies non-monotonically with the threshold level. For risk-taking, the effects are positive for high thresholds and negative for low thresholds. We characterize these patterns through the subtle interplay between effort and risk, which transition from complements to substitutes as thresholds become more demanding. Our experiment (N=1092) supports the theoretical predictions, showing that high thresholds raise both effort and risk-taking, whereas more moderate thresholds raise effort but lower risk-taking. Importantly, the experiment sheds light on the crucial role of individual heterogeneity: because individuals have different baseline performances, the same threshold can be perceived as high by some and low by others, producing opposite behavioral responses. The analysis highlights that effective threshold design must understand not only how thresholds shape effort and risk-taking, but also the characteristics of the targeted population.
abstract_zh: 我们从理论和实验两方面研究了绩效门槛对努力和风险承担的影响。我们的理论预测，门槛通常会提高努力水平，但这种提高的幅度随门槛水平呈非单调变化。对于风险承担，高门槛产生正向效应，低门槛则产生负向效应。我们通过努力与风险之间微妙的相互作用来刻画这些模式，随着门槛变得更加严格，两者从互补关系转变为替代关系。我们的实验（N=1092）支持了理论预测，表明高门槛同时提升努力和风险承担，而较为适中的门槛则提升努力但降低风险承担。重要的是，实验揭示了个人异质性的关键作用：由于个体基线绩效不同，同一门槛可能被一些人视为高门槛，而被另一些人视为低门槛，从而产生相反的行为反应。分析强调，有效的门槛设计不仅需要理解门槛如何塑造努力和风险承担，还需了解目标人群的特征。
title: Performance thresholds, effort and risk-taking
title_zh: 绩效阈值、努力与风险承担

abstract: This paper documents two strategies used to circumvent trade sanctions imposed on Russia following its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. The first involves transshipment through countries that do not participate in the sanctions regime. The second—simple yet largely undocumented—entails goods nominally shipped to neighbouring countries via Russia but failing to reach their declared final destination. Focusing on Armenia, Kazakhstan, and the Kyrgyz Republic, we show that during 2022–23 the two strategies offset roughly one third of the decline in European exports to Russia prompted by product-specific trade sanctions. We further find that sanctions led to only a modest increase in the unit values of products exported to Russia by both sanctioning and non-sanctioning economies.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了两种规避2022年俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰后所施加贸易制裁的策略。第一种涉及通过未参与制裁制度的国家进行转运。第二种——简单但鲜有记录——是指货物名义上经由俄罗斯运往邻国，却未能抵达其申报的最终目的地。聚焦于亚美尼亚、哈萨克斯坦和吉尔吉斯共和国，我们表明在2022至2023年间，这两种策略抵消了因产品特定贸易制裁而导致的欧洲对俄出口下降约三分之一。我们进一步发现，制裁仅使制裁国与非制裁经济体对俄出口产品的单位价值出现温和增长。
title: The Eurasian roundabout: Trade flows into Russia through the Caucasus and Central Asia
title_zh: 欧亚环岛：经由高加索和中亚流入俄罗斯的贸易流

abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between energy shocks, monetary policy responses, and inflation inequality, defined as the gap between consumer price inflation faced by households at the bottom and at the top of the expenditure distribution, arising from differences in consumption baskets. We use a VAR-based framework to quantify the impact of energy shocks on inflation inequality and to document their contribution to fluctuations in inflation differentials over time. To interpret the empirical evidence, we develop a two-agent general equilibrium model that sheds light on the underlying mechanisms. We show that the impact of energy shocks on inflation inequality intensifies when monetary policy reacts more forcefully to inflation. By estimating the model for the Italian economy, we assess the joint roles of energy shocks and monetary policy in driving the record level of inflation inequality observed in 2022, thereby providing empirical support for the mechanisms highlighted in the theoretical model.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了能源冲击、货币政策响应与通胀不平等之间的关系，其中通胀不平等定义为因消费篮子差异而导致的支出分布底层与顶层家庭所面临的消费者价格通胀之间的差距。我们采用基于VAR的框架来量化能源冲击对通胀不平等的影响，并记录其对通胀差异随时间波动的贡献。为解释实证证据，我们构建了一个双主体一般均衡模型，以揭示潜在机制。研究表明，当货币政策对通胀反应更为强烈时，能源冲击对通胀不平等的影响会加剧。通过针对意大利经济估计该模型，我们评估了能源冲击与货币政策在推动2022年观察到的创纪录通胀不平等水平中的共同作用，从而为理论模型所强调的机制提供了实证支持。
title: Inflation is not equal for all: The heterogeneous effects of energy shocks
title_zh: 通胀并非人人平等：能源冲击的异质性效应

abstract: Attitudes to inequality differ across countries and contexts, and understanding these differences is important for the design of redistributive policies. We here present evidence on fairness preferences in Kenya, based on a series of lab experiments with participants from Nairobi's largest informal settlement and its main university. This innovative sample allows us to compare the attitudes and beliefs of two important groups in society: the poor and the educated. We find that while the participants from the informal settlements are more egalitarian than the university students, they are less egalitarian than what is generally perceived. A second important finding is the sharp distinction made between distribution and redistribution, where participants are far more willing to equalize funds with no clear ownership compared to funds where there is an ex-ante allocation. Finally, many participants view luck as a more deserving source of inequality than performance, an observation that is contrary to what is commonly found in the literature. Our results highlight the complexity of people's fairness views and show the importance of not relying on stereotypes when designing redistributive policies that harmonize with local norms.
abstract_zh: 不同国家与情境下，人们对不平等的态度各异，理解这些差异对于设计再分配政策至关重要。本文基于在内罗毕最大非正规居住区及其主要大学参与者中进行的一系列实验室实验，提供了关于肯尼亚公平偏好的证据。这一创新样本使我们能够比较社会中两个重要群体——贫困群体与受过教育群体——的态度与信念。我们发现，尽管非正规居住区的参与者比大学生更倾向于平等主义，但他们的平等主义程度低于普遍认知。第二个重要发现是，在分配与再分配之间存在显著区分，参与者更愿意均等化无明确所有权的资金，而对于存在事前分配的资金则意愿较低。最后，许多参与者认为运气比表现更应成为不平等的来源，这一观察与文献中常见结论相悖。我们的结果凸显了人们公平观念的复杂性，并表明在设计符合当地规范的再分配政策时，不应依赖刻板印象的重要性。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 247
title: Fair inequality? Lab evidence from Kenya
title_zh: 公平不平等？来自肯尼亚的实验证据

abstract: The idea that patience is an important determinant of economic growth is well rooted in the economic literature. This paper investigates the causal relationship going in the opposite direction, i.e., from growth to patience. We propose a simple theoretical framework where patience evolves endogenously over time as a result of parental effort to transmit it to their offspring. Our model links such effort, and thus the overall level of patience in an economy, to economic growth. We corroborate our theoretical mechanism by estimating the impact of growth shocks on proxies of both patience and parental engagement to educate children to patience.
abstract_zh: 耐心是经济增长重要决定因素的观点在经济文献中根深蒂固。本文探讨了相反方向的因果关系，即从经济增长到耐心。我们提出了一个简单的理论框架，其中耐心随时间内生演化，源于父母将其传递给后代的努力。我们的模型将这种努力，以及经济中耐心的总体水平，与经济增长联系起来。我们通过估计增长冲击对耐心代理指标及父母教育孩子耐心参与度的影响，来验证我们的理论机制。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 247
title: The impact of growth on the transmission of patience
title_zh: 增长对耐心传导的影响

abstract: Credence goods markets are prone to fraudulent behavior and market inefficiencies due to informational asymmetries between sellers and customers. We examine experimentally the effects of diagnostic uncertainty and insurance coverage on the information acquisition and provision decisions by sellers and the trading decisions by consumers. Our results reveal that diagnostic uncertainty is a major source of inefficiency that decreases efficient service provision. Insurance coverage has a positive net effect on market efficiency, despite making information acquisition and efficient service provision less likely.
abstract_zh: 信任品市场因卖方与顾客之间的信息不对称，易发生欺诈行为并导致市场效率低下。我们通过实验考察了诊断不确定性和保险覆盖对卖方信息获取与提供决策以及消费者交易决策的影响。结果显示，诊断不确定性是导致效率下降的主要来源，它减少了高效服务的提供。尽管保险覆盖降低了信息获取和高效服务提供的可能性，但其对市场效率具有正向净效应。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 247
title: Diagnostic uncertainty and insurance coverage in credence goods markets: An experiment
title_zh: 信任品市场中的诊断不确定性与保险覆盖：一项实验研究

abstract: Using a triple difference estimation strategy, we compare the labour market outcomes of men and women before and just after the implementation of extended maternity leave policy across age profiles of individuals, in India. We find a negative impact of the maternity leave extension policy on the employment of women in high-fertility age cohorts. To explain this intuitively, we adapt a stylized micro-founded model of life-cycle search and matching friction in a gendered environment where the additional cost burden of maternity leave is borne by the firms, as is the case in India. We argue that if the firm’s cost from longer maternity leave duration outweighs the gain from retaining a worker, then the probability of being employed for fertile-age female workers decreases; via increased reservation productivity and decreased market tightness. Our empirical results and theoretical framework underscore the fact that even a well-intended policy design must be cognizant of underlying labour market dynamics to avoid exacerbating gender differences in labour markets.
abstract_zh: 采用三重差分估计策略，我们比较了印度实施延长产假政策前后，不同年龄段个体的男女劳动力市场结果。我们发现，延长产假政策对高生育年龄段女性的就业产生了负面影响。为直观解释这一现象，我们构建了一个基于生命周期搜索与匹配摩擦的微观基础模型，并置于性别化环境中，其中产假带来的额外成本负担由企业承担，正如印度的情况。我们认为，如果企业因延长产假而承担的成本超过保留员工的收益，那么育龄女性工人的就业概率将下降；这通过提高保留生产率和降低市场紧密度实现。我们的实证结果和理论框架强调，即使是意图良好的政策设计，也必须认识到潜在的劳动力市场动态，以避免加剧劳动力市场中的性别差异。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 247
title: Maternity leave and labour market outcomes
title_zh: 产假与劳动力市场结果

abstract: Physical laboratory experiments occupy a key position within experimental economics for a wide range of research questions, offering crucial methodological rigor by ensuring human authenticity, controlling informational conditions, directing interpersonal interactions, ensuring protocol credibility, and reliably administering monetary incentives. These factors contribute to the empirical robustness of experimental findings. The continued advancement of online experimental platforms offers complementary scientific benefits to laboratory experiments, such as lowering costs and increasing sample diversity. We identify and elaborate on specific research questions for which laboratory-based methods offer clear scientific advantages, emphasizing their ability to yield precise, insightful, and replicable data.
abstract_zh: 物理实验室实验在实验经济学中占据关键地位，适用于广泛的研究问题，通过确保人类真实性、控制信息条件、引导人际互动、保证协议可信度以及可靠实施货币激励，提供了至关重要的方法论严谨性。这些因素有助于增强实验发现的经验稳健性。在线实验平台的持续进步为实验室实验提供了互补的科学优势，例如降低成本和提高样本多样性。我们识别并详细阐述了实验室方法具有明显科学优势的具体研究问题，强调其在生成精确、深刻且可复制数据方面的能力。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 247
title: The virtues of lab experiments
title_zh: 实验室实验的优点

abstract: This study extends the monocentric city model to incorporate endogenous household automobile fuel choice and dwelling energy consumption. Electric vehicle (EV) tax credits lower direct energy consumption and emissions via commuting but also cause important urban general equilibrium effects, including sprawl. This creates a substantial emissions rebound effect via larger homes, longer commutes, and greater consumption of the numeraire good. Nevertheless, EV tax credits are welfare enhancing unless electricity production is heavily tilted toward coal, with total household energy consumption and carbon emissions falling substantially.
abstract_zh: 本研究将单中心城市模型扩展至包含内生家庭汽车燃料选择和住宅能源消耗。电动汽车税收抵免通过通勤降低了直接能源消耗和排放，但也引发了重要的城市一般均衡效应，包括城市蔓延。这通过更大的住房、更长的通勤距离以及对计价商品消费的增加，产生了显著的排放反弹效应。尽管如此，除非电力生产严重偏向煤炭，电动汽车税收抵免仍能提升福利，且家庭总能源消耗和碳排放显著下降。
journal: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
title: The Urban Equilibrium Effects of Electric Vehicle Tax Credits
title_zh: 电动汽车税收抵免的城市均衡效应

abstract: This study examines a Pennsylvania policy reform that increased bonded liability for coal mines with reclamation obligations. A 2001 change for surface mines was largely priced into existing reclamation insurance mechanisms, which exist to prevent mines from shirking their liabilities. We find that the changes increased mine-level insured liability and idling (≈15% for median mines), led to declines in production, and did not change environmental performance directly for treated mines. However, we do find that these effects were driven largely by higher polluting mines. Major results are robust to both comparing bituminous and anthracite mines within Pennsylvania as well as bituminous mines between Pennsylvania and Virginia.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了宾夕法尼亚州一项政策改革，该改革提高了负有复垦义务的煤矿的有担保负债。2001年针对露天矿的一项变更，在很大程度上已被纳入现有的复垦保险机制中，该机制旨在防止煤矿逃避其责任。我们发现，这些变化增加了矿井层面的保险负债和闲置率（中位数矿井约15%），导致产量下降，且未直接改变受处理矿井的环境绩效。然而，我们确实发现这些效应主要由污染较高的矿井驱动。主要结果在比较宾夕法尼亚州内部的烟煤和无烟煤矿井，以及宾夕法尼亚州与弗吉尼亚州之间的烟煤矿井时均保持稳健。
journal: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
title: Environmental Liability, Insurance, and Market Structure in Coal Mining
title_zh: 煤矿开采中的环境责任、保险与市场结构

abstract: This study examines the effects of droughts on economic activity, proxied by nighttime lights. Using two different indices of drought severity, one remotely sensed and one from ground-sensed meteorological data, we provide some of the first global estimates of the economic effects of drought, as opposed to temperature and precipitation. Economic impacts depend on drought severity, with moderate-or-worse droughts reducing luminosity by about 2%. Water storage in the form of accessible groundwater mitigates drought impacts. Dams moderate the effects of all but the most extreme droughts. For moderate or worse droughts, negative effects are fully offset by the presence of dams, unless some dams are hydroelectric. Upstream dams do not appear to create harmful spillovers for drought resilience downstream. Results are robust to allowing separate mediating impacts from irrigation and suggest that the resilience benefits of dams and groundwater extend beyond agriculture.
abstract_zh: 本研究以夜间灯光作为经济活动代理变量，考察干旱对经济活动的影响。利用两种干旱严重程度指数——一种基于遥感数据，另一种基于地面气象观测数据——我们提供了全球范围内干旱（而非温度和降水）经济影响的首批估计之一。经济影响取决于干旱严重程度，中度及以上干旱会使夜间灯光亮度降低约2%。以可获取地下水形式存在的水储量能够缓解干旱影响。水坝可减轻除极端干旱外所有干旱的影响。对于中度及以上干旱，除非部分水坝用于水力发电，否则其负面影响可被水坝完全抵消。上游水坝似乎不会对下游抗旱韧性产生有害溢出效应。在允许灌溉产生独立中介效应的条件下，结果依然稳健，并表明水坝和地下水的韧性效益不仅限于农业领域。
journal: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
title: Droughts and Economic Activity: Do Dams and Groundwater Mediate the Impact?
title_zh: 干旱与经济活动：水坝与地下水能否缓解其影响？

abstract: Emerging datasets capture rich temporal variation in recreation behavior, but recreation demand analyses have traditionally used variation across sites, rather than across time, to value environmental amenities. We introduce a model and estimation procedure designed to exploit panel variation in recreation demand analyses by embedding panel data causal inference techniques within a travel cost random utility model. To demonstrate the method, we use “structural synthetic controls” to value the welfare losses caused by water-quality-induced beach closures in southeast Michigan. Losses tend to be larger on weekends and hotter days, and our results suggest that a stigma effect reduces visitation even after the beach reopens. Our method is particularly useful for valuing the recreational impacts of resource shocks, like harmful algal blooms or wildfires, and it can be applied broadly given the increasing availability of high-frequency recreation data.
abstract_zh: 新兴数据集捕捉了休闲行为中丰富的时间变化，但传统的休闲需求分析通常利用地点间的差异，而非时间上的差异，来评估环境设施的价值。我们提出了一种模型和估计程序，旨在通过将面板数据因果推断技术嵌入旅行成本随机效用模型中，利用休闲需求分析中的面板变化。为演示该方法，我们采用“结构合成控制法”来评估密歇根州东南部因水质引起的海滩关闭所造成的福利损失。损失在周末和炎热天气下往往更大，我们的结果表明，即使在海滩重新开放后，污名效应仍会减少游客访问量。我们的方法特别适用于评估资源冲击（如有害藻华或野火）对休闲活动的影响，并且随着高频休闲数据的日益可得，该方法可广泛应用。
journal: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
title: Causal Inference, High-Frequency Data, and the Recreational Value of Water Quality
title_zh: 因果推断、高频数据与水质的休闲价值

abstract: College education, homeownership, and automobiles are all examples of purchases where consumers sink a large up-front investment expecting to enjoy a stream of future net benefits. Often those benefits are uncertain at the time of purchase. We consider how uncertainty in future operating costs impacts the choice of vehicle fuel economy. Using measures of future gasoline price uncertainty from real options theory and comprehensive data on sales of automobiles in the United States, we find that future gasoline price uncertainty has economically meaningful impacts on vehicle demand, with a one standard deviation increase in the variance of the future price distribution increasing willingness to pay for fuel economy by 6.7%, slightly improving mean fuel economy but substantially reducing short-run vehicle sales. This new finding has implications for transportation policies that may introduce new uncertainties in future vehicle operating costs.
abstract_zh: 大学教育、购房和汽车均是消费者投入大量前期资金以期获得未来净收益流的购买行为。然而，这些收益在购买时往往存在不确定性。我们探讨了未来运营成本的不确定性如何影响车辆燃油经济性的选择。借助实物期权理论中的未来汽油价格不确定性度量指标，以及美国汽车销售的全面数据，我们发现未来汽油价格的不确定性对车辆需求具有经济意义上的显著影响：未来价格分布方差每增加一个标准差，消费者对燃油经济性的支付意愿将提高6.7%，平均燃油经济性略有改善，但短期内汽车销量显著下降。这一新发现对可能引入未来车辆运营成本新不确定性的交通政策具有启示意义。
journal: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
title: A Hedge Fund in Your Garage: Automobile Purchases Under Gasoline Price            Uncertainty
title_zh: 车库里的对冲基金：汽油价格不确定性下的汽车购买行为

abstract: Utilities have invested billions of dollars in advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) but proceeded slowly to deploy AMI-enabled programs that benefit consumers. High bill alert (HBA) programs, which inform consumers of unusually high usage patterns, offer an avenue for tapping AMI-enabled benefits. We evaluate an HBA program and find that the program reduced mean electricity and natural gas consumption by about 0.5%. The effects were largest at the top of the usage distribution, especially when normalized by preprogram usage, indicating that households experienced fewer expenditure shocks. Estimates of the program’s benefits and costs illustrate the importance of considering the forgone value of conserved energy when evaluating demand-side management programs in the energy sector.
abstract_zh: 公用事业公司在先进计量基础设施（AMI）上投入了数十亿美元，但在部署惠及消费者的AMI相关项目方面进展缓慢。高用量提醒（HBA）项目通过告知消费者异常高的用电模式，为挖掘AMI带来的益处提供了途径。我们评估了一个HBA项目，发现该项目使平均电力和天然气消耗降低了约0.5%。影响在使用量分布的高端最为显著，尤其是在按项目前使用量进行标准化后，这表明家庭经历的支出冲击有所减少。对该项目收益与成本的估算显示，在评估能源领域的需求侧管理项目时，考虑节约能源的放弃价值至关重要。
journal: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
title: Shock Avoidance: High Bill Alert Programs and Energy Consumption
title_zh: 避免冲击：高额账单预警项目与能源消费

abstract: Researchers deploying stated preference surveys to value public goods commonly use techniques designed to reduce bias in hypothetical choice settings. This practice is at odds with evidence that most survey respondents perceive that their decisions are not hypothetical but instead have economic consequences. We examine three bias reduction procedures in both hypothetical and incentive-compatible, real payment settings: cheap talk, solemn oath, and certainty adjustment. We confirm that adjusting hypothetical choices based on response certainty or using a solemn oath can reduce hypothetical bias. In the incentive-compatible decision setting, the oath increases willingness to pay (WTP), and certainty adjustment can lead to serious distortions in demand estimates. Cheap talk does not alter mean WTP but leads to a stark difference in WTP across sexes. To minimize unintended consequences, our results suggest that survey researchers should deploy screening questions to better target these hypothetical bias reduction techniques.
abstract_zh: 研究人员在评估公共物品价值时，常采用陈述偏好调查，并运用旨在减少假设性选择情境中偏差的技术。然而，这一做法与多数调查受访者认为其决策并非假设性而是具有经济后果的证据相悖。我们在假设性及激励兼容的真实支付情境中，考察了三种偏差减少程序：廉价谈话、庄严宣誓及确定性调整。我们确认，基于响应确定性调整假设性选择或采用庄严宣誓可减少假设性偏差。在激励兼容的决策情境下，宣誓增加了支付意愿（WTP），而确定性调整可能导致需求估计的严重扭曲。廉价谈话虽不改变平均WTP，但导致不同性别间WTP的显著差异。为最小化非预期后果，我们的研究结果表明，调查研究者应部署筛选问题，以更精准地应用这些假设性偏差减少技术。
journal: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
title: Are We Doing More Harm than Good? Using Hypothetical Bias Reduction Techniques in Consequential Decision Settings
title_zh: 我们是否弊大于利？在后果性决策情境中使用假设性偏差减少技术

abstract: As the largest user of global water, irrigated agriculture accounts for 20% of global cropland and 40% of food production. Irrigation is also a potential adaptive response to drought and extreme temperatures. This paper examines the extent to which the current global irrigation footprint reflects climate change over the last 50 years. Utilizing exogenous variation in geological structure, I find evidence that farmers adapt by increasing groundwater irrigation in places that became dryer and hotter. The results hold globally and in the US. Observed recent warming is responsible for 9% of global irrigation growth. GRACE satellite data shows that climate-driven irrigation contributes to aquifer stress, as well as increased soil salinity, thus representing large negative externalities of adaptation to climate change and a potential threat to future food security. ∗I would like to thank Wolfram Schlenker, Frances Moore, Douglas Almond, Jaime Mullins, Geoffrey Heal, Pierre Gentine, Thomas Braun, and Jeffrey Shrader for their comments, as well as participants at the AERE@EEA conference, WEAI conference, and Climate Economics Workshop at UC Berkeley. †School of International and Public Affairs and The Earth Institute, Columbia University. cat2180@columbia.edu
abstract_zh: 作为全球最大的水资源使用者，灌溉农业占据了全球耕地的20%和粮食产量的40%。灌溉也是对干旱和极端温度的一种潜在适应性响应。本文考察了当前全球灌溉足迹在多大程度上反映了过去50年的气候变化。利用地质构造的外生变异，我发现了农民通过在地势更干燥、温度更高的地区增加地下水灌溉来适应气候变化的证据。这一结果在全球范围内以及美国均成立。观测到的近期变暖现象导致了全球灌溉增长的9%。GRACE卫星数据显示，气候驱动的灌溉加剧了含水层压力，并增加了土壤盐碱度，从而代表了适应气候变化带来的巨大负面外部性，以及对未来粮食安全的潜在威胁。
journal: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
title: Irrigation and Climate Change: Long-Run Adaptation and Its Externalities
title_zh: 灌溉与气候变化：长期适应及其外部性

abstract: This study makes a significant contribution to the expanding body of literature on the energy-growth nexus, distinguishing itself in two important ways. First, this is the first meta-analysis that systematically compares the economic growth impacts of renewable versus nonrenewable energy sources, instead of relying on aggregate energy indicators. Second, it explicitly explores the heterogeneity of these effects in the context of developing countries. These elasticities exhibit notable nonlinearity, following a U-shaped pattern across stages of development. In low-income countries, the relatively higher elasticity for both energy types likely reflects the critical need to expand access, regardless of the source. As countries move up the income ladder, the elasticity of renewables tends to decline, potentially reflecting short-term frictions and adjustments associated with the integration of intermittent sources, and comes to a plateau for high-income countries. In contrast, fossil fuels may remain essential in higher-income contexts for supporting grid stability and storage as renewable energy becomes more integrated. The findings underscore the need for customized energy policies that correspond to each country's economic development stage. In low-income countries, policies should focus on expanding access to affordable and reliable energy sources. In developed economies, policies should aim to encourage innovations in clean energy technologies and support technology transfer to developing countries, assisting them in sustainably meeting their energy requirements for economic growth.
abstract_zh: 本研究对能源与经济增长关系的文献体系做出了重要贡献，其独特性体现在两个方面。首先，这是首项系统比较可再生能源与不可再生能源对经济增长影响的元分析研究，而非依赖总体能源指标。其次，本研究明确探讨了发展中国家情境下这些影响的异质性特征。这些弹性系数呈现显著的非线性特征，在经济发展阶段中呈U型分布。在低收入国家，两种能源类型均表现出相对较高的弹性，这很可能反映了无论能源来源如何，扩大能源可及性的迫切需求。随着国家收入水平提升，可再生能源弹性趋于下降，这或许反映了间歇性能源整合过程中的短期摩擦与调整，并在高收入国家趋于平稳。相比之下，在可再生能源整合程度加深的背景下，化石燃料在高收入经济体中对维持电网稳定性和储能仍具关键作用。研究结果强调，能源政策需根据各国经济发展阶段进行定制化设计。在低收入国家，政策应聚焦于扩大可负担且可靠能源的可及性；在发达经济体，政策应着力于激励清洁能源技术创新，并支持向发展中国家进行技术转移，协助其以可持续方式满足经济增长所需的能源需求。

title: Assessing the Impact of Renewable versus Fossil Fuels Energy on Economic Growth: A Meta-Analysis of the Elasticity across Development Stages
title_zh: 可再生能源与化石燃料能源对经济增长影响的评估：基于发展阶段弹性的元分析

abstract: Sovereigns self-insure via reserve accumulation, prioritizing liquidity over yield. This practice imposes opportunity costs and can amplify the convenience premium on traditional reserve assets. This paper evaluates Synthetic Reserve Deposits (SRDs), a pooling mechanism designed to improve the return-liquidity trade-off. Participants would hold floating-value claims on a vehicle comprising a settlement buffer, an investment portfolio, and, in some designs, an optional collateralized liquidity window. The architecture separates the allocation of portfolio risk from the provision of short-term foreign-currency liquidity: market risk remains with SRD holders, while liquidity is provided through redemption at contemporaneous executable value or through secured advances. Simulations illustrate that the structure can shift the return-liquidity frontier outward under explicit downside-risk constraints. General equilibrium modeling suggests that, if implemented at sufficient scale and under appropriate conditions, reallocating reserve demand through this mechanism could increase the effective supply of reserve claims and affect the global financial cycle, creating aggregate welfare gains and possibly Pareto improvements depending on initial global asset positions.
abstract_zh: 主权国家通过积累外汇储备进行自我保险，优先考虑流动性而非收益。这种做法会产生机会成本，并可能放大传统储备资产的便利溢价。本文评估了合成储备存款（SRDs）这一旨在改善收益-流动性权衡的集合机制。参与者将持有对某一工具的可变价值债权，该工具包含结算缓冲池、投资组合，以及在某些设计中增设的可选抵押流动性窗口。该架构将组合风险配置与短期外币流动性供给相分离：市场风险由SRD持有者承担，流动性则通过按当前可执行价值赎回或通过担保垫款提供。模拟分析表明，在明确的下行风险约束下，该结构可将收益-流动性边界向外推移。一般均衡模型显示，若在适当条件下以足够规模实施，通过该机制重新配置储备需求可增加储备债权的有效供给，影响全球金融周期，产生总体福利收益，并可能根据初始全球资产头寸实现帕累托改进。
title: Upgrading the Global Financial Safety Net: Implications of a Synthetic Reserve Deposit
title_zh: 升级全球金融安全网：合成储备存款的影响

abstract: This paper examines macrofinancial linkages between property developers, financial institutions, and macroeconomic outcomes in China. Using a parsimonious vector autoregressive (VAR) model enabled by a machine learning algorithm, it quantifies how idiosyncratic shocks can propagate and be amplified across sectors, with potential implications for financial stability. Stress originating from privately owned developers and regionally focused financial institutions—though relatively limited in scale—can generate persistent spillovers through lending relationships, common exposures, shared markets, and changes in market sentiment. A decline in property prices may undermine investment, weaken consumer confidence, and adversely affect the health of both the property and financial sectors, thereby disrupting financial intermediation and weighing on broader economic growth. Policy considerations should take into account these feedback loops. Market- and exposure-based tools can be helpful for monitoring macrofinancial linkages and assessing the transmission of shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国房地产开发商、金融机构与宏观经济结果之间的宏观金融关联。借助机器学习算法构建的简约向量自回归（VAR）模型，本文量化了异质性冲击如何通过部门间传导与放大，并对金融稳定产生潜在影响。源自私营开发商及区域性金融机构的压力——尽管规模相对有限——可通过信贷关系、共同风险敞口、共享市场及市场情绪变化，产生持续性的溢出效应。房价下跌可能削弱投资、打击消费者信心，并对房地产与金融部门的健康状况造成不利影响，进而扰乱金融中介功能，拖累整体经济增长。政策制定需充分考虑这些反馈循环。基于市场与风险敞口的工具，有助于监测宏观金融关联并评估冲击传导机制。
authors: Jin-Chuan Duan & Mr. Dimitrios Laliotis & Ms. Wei Sun

title: Assessing Macrofinancial Linkages in China Using a Machine-Learned Parsimonious VAR Model
title_zh: 基于机器学习简约VAR模型的中国宏观金融关联性评估

abstract: More frequent large macroeconomic shocks since the global financial crisis have entrenched uncertainty, particularly in Europe. This has increased the premium on central bank communication in guiding expectations and strengthening macroeconomic resilience. European central banks have responded by adapting their communication toolkits and styles. This study provides a systematic assessment of recent central bank communication across advanced and emerging European economies, combining a survey of institutional communication frameworks with novel text-miningbased indicators on monetary policy guidance in these economies over 2009-2025. While communication toolkits are broadly similar, their intensity and transparency differ markedly, with central banks in advanced economies making greater use of forward-looking tools. Central banks in both groups respond primarily to inflation uncertainty. However, communication strategies diverge, as central banks in advanced economies increasingly shift toward forward-looking language, whereas those in emerging markets shift toward more backward-looking communication. These patterns highlight credibility and institutional capacity as key determinants of central bank communication under uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 自全球金融危机以来，频繁发生的宏观经济冲击加剧了不确定性，尤其是在欧洲地区。这提升了央行沟通在引导预期和增强宏观经济韧性方面的价值。欧洲各国央行通过调整其沟通工具包和风格予以应对。本研究结合对机构沟通框架的调查，以及基于文本挖掘技术构建的2009-2025年欧洲发达与新兴经济体货币政策指引新指标，系统评估了近期欧洲各国央行的沟通实践。尽管沟通工具包大致相似，但其使用强度和透明度存在显著差异——发达经济体央行更频繁运用前瞻性工具。两组央行均主要对通胀不确定性作出反应，但沟通策略呈现分化：发达经济体央行日益转向前瞻性表述，而新兴市场央行则更多采用后顾式沟通。这些模式凸显了在不确定性环境下，可信度与制度能力是决定央行沟通策略的关键因素。
authors: Francesca Caselli & Ms. Luisa Charry & Mr. Larry Q Cui & Mr. Pragyan Deb & Allan Dizioli & Alexandra Fotiou & Ben Park & Mr. Sebastian Weber
title: Central Bank Communication in Times of Uncertainty: AI-assisted Decoding of Recent Trends in Europe
title_zh: 不确定性时期的央行沟通：欧洲近期趋势的AI辅助解读

abstract: After decades in the making, Brazil’s landmark VAT reform was approved in 2023. The primary objective of the reform is to eliminate distortions and reduce the complexity of the current consumption tax system while maintaining revenue neutrality. In addition, specific design features were included to alleviate the VAT’s inherent regressivity and improve the equity of the Brazilian tax system. This paper assesses the reform’s expected equity print leveraging a microstatic model based on household data and simulates policy options to further improve distributional outcomes. While the new VAT achieves a fairly equal distribution of the tax burden across most income groups, the poorest still carry a heavier load in terms of their disposable income. Dissecting the impact by policy instrument, the reform’s approved reduced rates aggravate regressivity, while zero rates and the new cashback lower the tax burden for poorer households, under the revenue neutrality assumption. Overall, the combined use of these measures dampens the reform’s equity outcomes somewhat as a higher VAT reference rate is required on all other items to maintain revenue neutrality. The paper also shows that some equity improvements stem from the reform’s implied pivot towards taxing services. Finally, simulations show that focusing on and expanding the cashback could amplify equity gains by raising the poorest disposable income by 25 percent via reductions in their tax liability.
abstract_zh: 历经数十年酝酿，巴西里程碑式的增值税改革于2023年获批。此次改革的首要目标是在保持税收中性前提下，消除现行消费税体系的扭曲效应并降低其复杂性。此外，改革还纳入了特定设计特征，以缓解增值税固有的累退性，提升巴西税收体系的公平性。本文基于家庭数据的微观静态模型评估了改革预期的公平性影响，并模拟了进一步改善分配结果的备选政策方案。尽管新增值税制在多数收入群体间实现了较为均衡的税负分配，但最贫困群体在可支配收入层面仍承担着更重的负担。按政策工具分解影响可见：在税收中性假设下，改革批准的优惠税率加剧了累退性，而零税率与新推行的现金返还机制则降低了贫困家庭的税负。总体而言，这些措施的联合使用在一定程度上削弱了改革的公平性效果——为维持税收中性，所有其他商品需适用更高的增值税基准税率。本文还表明，部分公平性改善源于改革隐含的服务业征税重心转移。最后，模拟结果显示，聚焦并扩大现金返还机制可通过减少贫困群体税负使其可支配收入提升25%，从而放大公平性收益。
authors: Ana Cebreiro Gomez & Ms. Christina Kolerus
title: Brazil's VAT Reform: Improving Equity
title_zh: 巴西增值税改革：提升公平性

abstract: Exchange rate movements have implications for the purchasing power of residents or voters. Given that the exchange rate is often seen as a barometer of government performance, there could be strong incentives to influence exchange rate valuation during elections. This paper investigates whether political economy factors affect Foreign Exchange Intervention (FXI) policy across countries. It investigates whether central banks tend to implement FX sales, leaning against depreciations, during electoral periods in a sample of 28 countries including both advanced (AEs) and emerging (EMs) economies over the period 2000-2019. The results show that EMs with competitive elections tend to implement more and larger FX sales in pre-electoral period, compared to post-election period, given their political popularity. Further, this result is driven by countries where political pressures on central bank governors are more prevalent. Furthermore, the paper also finds that monetary policy transparency has the potential to mitigate this politically driven FXI during electoral period. Finally, the paper discusses policy implications given that politically motivated FX sales could hamper the ability of central banks to effectively respond to large shocks.
abstract_zh: 汇率变动对居民或选民的购买力具有重要影响。鉴于汇率常被视为政府绩效的晴雨表，选举期间可能存在强烈动机干预汇率估值。本文研究政治经济因素是否会影响各国的外汇干预政策，基于2000-2019年涵盖28个经济体（包括发达经济体和新兴经济体）的样本，考察央行是否倾向于在选举期间实施外汇抛售以应对本币贬值压力。结果表明，具有竞争性选举的新兴经济体在选举前阶段，出于政治声望考量，会实施更多且规模更大的外汇抛售。进一步分析显示，这一结果在央行行长面临更普遍政治压力的国家尤为显著。此外，本文还发现货币政策透明度具有缓解选举期间政治驱动型外汇干预的潜力。最后，本文讨论了政策启示：出于政治动机的外汇抛售可能削弱央行有效应对重大冲击的能力。
title: The Political Economy of Foreign Exchange Interventions
title_zh: 外汇干预的政治经济学

abstract: I study how the production network shapes monetary policy transmission to prices. Using U.S. data, I show that industries farther upstream from final demand exhibit larger cumulative price responses to monetary shocks, while downstream industries absorb shocks through output. A calibrated multi-sector New Keynesian model rationalizes these patterns: upstream sectors, which sell predominantly to other firms, reprice more frequently and therefore exhibit less price rigidity. A counterfactual decomposition of the price response shows that this heterogeneity in price rigidity---rather than cost-cascade propagation through input-output linkages---is the primary driver of the cross-sectional responses. The upstreamness differential is strongly asymmetric, large following expansionary shocks but nearly absent following contractionary ones, consistent with asymmetric price rigidity compounding across production stages.
